dedupe_keys.name: iata one record air cargo data sharing standard data model ontology and api

description: ONE Record is an IATA standard for sharing air cargo shipment data that gives a single record view of each shipment across airlines, forwarders, handlers and data platforms. It defines a common data model in JSON-LD with an ontology, a web API specification for connecting systems directly, and a security specification based on a federated trust network, building on the e-freight and e-AWB programmes and moving beyond EDI messaging. It is maintained by IATA with its cargo boards, and the GitHub repository holds release folders, a working draft of the data model, ontology, API and security specifications, with a specification portal. Coverage is global. The specifications are free to read and available on GitHub under the MIT licence. Caveats: it is a standard, not a dataset, and shipment data stay with their owners, who decide who can access them; adoption varies by carrier (news items report airlines adopting it). It supports modelling of air cargo supply chains, digital twins of logistics flows and data exchange for disruption management. It complements the GS1 EPCIS supply chain event standard and is related to the DATEX II road traffic data standard.
